messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up — ran the first SI learning-path dry run this AM. Recording + slide deck here: <https://drive.redwood.ai/si-learning/retrospective|slides/rec>.
aj: Watched — really strong on hands‑on labs. Two quick notes: (1) lab 3 assumes CUDA on their laptop, (2) keep the doubt ladder examples shorter. :+1:
kevin: Re: lab 3 — we should add a containerized fallback (docker) so partners with no GPUs can still follow. Suggest adding a small command snippet they can run:
kevin: ```docker run --gpus all -it redwood/si-labs:cpu-fallback bash```
maria: Loved the 'rollout play' section. Suggest adding a one-pager checklist for pre-sales handoff.
olivia: Good call @kevin @maria — @rachel can you own adding docker fallback? Also @aj can you draft the one-pager checklist by EOD Wed?
rachel: I can take docker fallback. Will add a short script + README and put in the repo under /partners/si-resources.
aj: Yep I'll draft checklist. Quick question — certification exam: do we want multiple choice only or include a hands-on lab submission?
kevin: Prefer both. MCQ for baseline, one mini-lab for full cert.
partnerbot: Reminder — SI enablement deadline for Q2 milestone set to 2026-05-15. :bell:
maria: timeline works. Also propose a 30-min 'office hours' session after launch each week for 6 weeks.
olivia: Love it. Final asks: (1) docker fallback PR by Fri, (2) checklist draft by Wed EOD, (3) confirm cert format next sync. Tag me if blockers.
aj: On it. Thanks!
kevin: I'll sketch the lab rubric and post in #eng-ml for review.
rachel: PR created -> <https://git.redwood.ai/partners/si-resources/pull/42|#42>. PTAL.
olivia: Awesome — closing the loop here. :rocket:
